silent_failure_code_path.code: else { Write-PhetrailEntry -Type 'neutral' -Artifact 'obi:$Command' -Action 'attempted $Command (not yet implemented in Phase 1)'; Write-Host 'NOT IMPLEMENTED IN PHASE 1: $Command' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host 'Only doctor is wired for mechanical emission in this phase.' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host 'Trail written. Command not executed. See handoff-pipeline-round1.md for next pipes.' -ForegroundColor Cyan; exit 0 }
silent_failure_code_path.mechanism: Unimplemented commands write a NEUTRAL phetrail entry, print yellow text, and exit 0. No error thrown. CI/automation sees success. The command appears functional but produces zero effect.
silent_failure_code_path.danger: Automation scripts calling obi.ps1 verify or obi.ps1 forcemarch will receive exit 0 and assume success. No failure signal propagates.
